cli.about.long:
A Rust coding-agent harness: interactive REPL, headless mode, tool calling,
permission gating, subagent orchestration, Plan mode, and session resume.
Offline mock by default; set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY to use real models.

cli.slash.help:
Available commands:
  /help                 show this help
  /status               current provider / model / permission mode / session
  /model [name]         show or switch the model
  /permissions [mode]   show or switch the permission mode
  /plan /auto /bypass   quick permission-mode switches
  /default /accept-edits /dont-ask
  /cost                 token usage
  /clear                clear the current context
  /compact [n]          keep only the most recent n messages
  /image <path>         attach an image to the next prompt
  /agents               subagent list and status
  /sessions             sessions in this working directory
  /exit                 quit
